stock.description: Solomon Systech (International) Limited functions as an investment holding entity and a fabless semiconductor enterprise. The company's core activities revolve around the engineering, development, and distribution of integrated circuits (ICs) and system solutions for various display applications. Their extensive product line includes driver ICs for passive-matrix and active-matrix organic light-emitting diode (OLED) displays, as well as general OLED lighting and bistable displays. They also supply specialized IC solutions for large displays, such as source drivers, gate drivers, and GIP controllers. Additionally, Solomon Systech provides mobile display and touch ICs, covering technologies like in-cell touch, TFT, STN, MIPI bridge, and display controller ICs, alongside custom drivers for MiniLED/µLED applications. These innovative components facilitate display and touch functionalities in a broad spectrum of electronic devices, ranging from smartphones, tablets, televisions, and laptops to wearables, electronic shelf labels, healthcare equipment, smart home devices, and industrial machinery. Beyond its primary semiconductor operations, the company also offers market research services. Founded in 1999 and based in Sha Tin, Hong Kong, Solomon Systech boasts an international operational footprint spanning Hong Kong, Mainland China, Taiwan, Europe, Japan, Korea, Southeast Asia, the United States, and other global regions.
